source: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF), Department of Agricultural Extension — trifold "វិធីបណ្តុះកូនល្ហុង" (Method for Raising Papaya Seedlings), citing Training Module on Fruit Tree Production (2013) and a farmer's field experience from Kampong district, Preah Vihear province (2012)
text:
After the seeds have been shade-dried, wrap them in a cloth (or a small sack) and soak them in warm water. Keep the wrapped seeds away from direct sunlight, and moisten/water them twice a day so they do not dry out or shrivel while germinating.

Leave the seeds wrapped this way for about 7–10 days to encourage faster, more even germination before sowing them into nursery bags filled with fine, well-prepared soil.

Once sown in bags, keep the young seedlings under shade-net cover to protect them from strong sun and heavy rain until they are sturdy enough to be moved.
